entries.title: Hanuman Temple
entries.blurb: Seva at the temple: kitchen and annadanam, event setup, parking and crowd help, cleanup, and help at festivals. Sign up on the temple volunteer page.

entries.title: Hospital volunteering (medical)
entries.blurb: Volunteer inside Dallas County's public hospital: patient areas, information desks, clinics and student programs. Good exposure for anyone heading into healthcare.
entries.note: Parkland sets its own minimum age for each program - check the page before you apply.

entries.title: Business and community projects
entries.blurb: Team and individual projects across Dallas: financial coaching, fundraising, school and workforce programs. A practical way to see how a large nonprofit is run.
entries.note: United Way sets a minimum age for some projects - check the page before you apply.

entries.title: Legal aid clinics
entries.blurb: Free civil legal aid clinics for low income Dallas residents. Students and non-attorneys help at intake and with case support; attorneys take cases.
entries.note: Most clinic roles are for law students and attorneys; ask about student support roles.

entries.title: Tech mentoring and STEM events
entries.blurb: North Texas technology association: judge and mentor at student STEM events, help run programs, and meet people working in tech across DFW.

entries.title: Disaster relief and blood drives
entries.blurb: Disaster response teams, blood drive support, home fire safety visits and service to the armed forces across the North Texas region.
entries.note: The Red Cross sets a minimum age per role - check the page before you apply.
